evidence_requirements: Verify external amplifier ECU/J525 part number and full coding on the actual fitted vehicle, not brand alone
Prove native QNX audio stack, PCM sink and session/focus APIs for exact target firmware; no Audi Qualcomm drivers
Observe multichannel MOST route/format/width and channel-to-speaker assignments using safe tests without overwriting amplifier coding
Confirm six independent music PCM channels, centre and LFE, gain limits, output phase/cabin matrix and DSP CPU deadline
Isolate voice, navigation announcements, telephone and reverse camera audio from upmix; preserve existing stock mixer owner
Prove per-profile signed-off ABI build/source provenance, QNX regression, rollback and repeatable on-car A/B
audio.safe_fallback: Unmodified OEM stereo; never inject six-channel PCM or modify J525 without all gates

notes: Source-only profile declaration; exact firmware identification does not establish physical amplifier identity
